title: Read the failed Telegram tests on Windows and name the cause
goal: The cause of the 2026-11-16 Windows Telegram failures is named and fixed or bounded
acceptance: The failure messages and cause are in the record
A committed test fails first if the cause is in code
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-18: read the CI log, reproduce under load, fix or bound, one test. Not a measurement.
